objective: Prove that the screenshot-first pipeline can reproduce the official WHAT'S NEW editorial carousel without reopening the full-site learning scope.
mustPreserve: full-bleed white section field with separate content safe areas
desktop two-card and mobile one-card responsive recomposition
heading, archive link, image, headline, CTA and pagination hierarchy
visible translate, fade and scale carousel change
mustNot: reuse the existing generic news grid as proof
hard-code line breaks from Chrome-translated captures
promote yellow into a global title, active or primary-action color
claim exact entry-on-scroll or CTA hover-layer fidelity while unresolved
pass a carousel that changes only index, class or pagination

acceptance.evidence: Every required structure and motion claim traces to source capture, visible DOM/state and computed evidence, with unresolved facts kept unresolved.
acceptance.structure: Desktop shows two equal stories per page; mobile shows one edge-to-edge story per page; page count recomputes from three to six.
acceptance.visual: Source and Demo comparison preserves full-bleed boundary, title hierarchy, media ratio, CTA role and next-section seam.
acceptance.interaction: Before, transition, settled and restored states visibly change image, headline and CTA; controls are operable and accessible.
